toml_parser: stdlib tomllib on Python >=3.11; inert declared tomli compatibility on Python 3.10
text_encoding: strict UTF-8; preserve exact fetched bytes for hashes; parse logical lines with splitlines()
authentication: GITHUB_TOKEN or GH_TOKEN when already configured; otherwise public unauthenticated reads; never prompt or persist credentials
candidate_selection_order: root Python metadata in lexical path order
root license candidates in lexical path order
root dependency declarations and lockfiles in lexical path order
remaining deduplicated candidates in lexical path order

statuses.observed: At least one candidate was read and parsed under a supported rule; recognized facts remain observed when other selected files are unsupported, with unknown_count recorded.
statuses.missing: Complete tree and candidate scan found no in-scope candidate path.
statuses.uncertain: Incomplete tree, candidate cap, source-byte/file-size cap, invalid UTF-8, or parse ambiguity prevents a complete conclusion.
statuses.multiple_or_conflicting: Multiple evidence files or incompatible recognized declarations were observed under the group's conflict rule.
statuses.unsupported: Candidate bytes were read but syntax or source form is outside supported parser rules.

conflict_rules.python_versions: More than one distinct recognized declaration fact across files is multiple_or_conflicting.
conflict_rules.license: More than one in-scope license/copying/notice candidate file is multiple_or_conflicting, independent of identifier equality.
conflict_rules.dependencies: Different specifier strings for the same normalized dependency name are multiple_or_conflicting; otherwise supported facts remain observed.

mixed_supported_and_unsupported: Keep status observed when any selected source yields supported facts; include unsupported candidates in unknown_count and unsupported_syntax reason_codes.
dependency_declaration_fact: declarations_present is true, false, or null and is separate from the common status vocabulary
tree_policy: Use complete recursive tree; when truncated or response-capped, verify exact commit metadata as needed and walk nonrecursive tree objects with a visited set. Incomplete traversal is uncertain and never establishes absence.
blob_identity: Strictly decode API base64, require declared/tree sizes to agree, recompute SHA1('blob ' + ASCII(size) + NUL + raw bytes) and require tree OID match; record raw size and SHA-256.
global_failure_policy: Global request, response-byte, wall-time, report-size, checksum, authentication, lock-identity, or blob-identity failure aborts without publishing any artifact.
publication: Strict schema and exact lock identity validation; atomic same-directory hard-link no-clobber output.
interpretation_limits: source declarations and file presence only
no installed dependency feasibility or resolvability
no reviewer labels or canonical truth
